notes.notes:
Hi!

notes.title: Still Kicking
notes.notes:
Hey!

Just wanted to know that the game is still being developed and planned to release :)

This is a project that I'm doing after work, so there is going to be a delay in release date (moving it to Summer 2021), but rest assured that the game is going to see the light of the day eventually.
